Former Election Commissioners Question SIR Procedures, EC-SIR Row Spotlighted

Former Election Commissioners have raised questions about the legality of the Systemic Improvement and Reforms (SIR) procedures and sought clarity on changes to Form 6. The "EC-SIR row" has brought past differences within the Election Commission (EC) to the forefront. Some former CECs stated that decisions made without a majority are illegal. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has backed the EC in this row, asserting that opposition parties won seats they claimed were compromised by the poll body.
